verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR, payroll and PEO SaaS that holds sensitive employee data, so control over data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about retention policies, data deletion, export-then-delete, or account or data purge controls. The docs cover only payroll setup, benefits recording, time-off policies and Xero mappings; the ability to edit profile information before running payroll is a related feature, not retention or deletion control.
